-- Ambiguous: interpreting as sales trend
SELECT toYear(s.DateKey) as year, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales, sum(s.SalesAmount) - lag(sum(s.SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(s.DateKey)) as yoy_change FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE pc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras and camcorders' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
